result.summary: Found 1 major issue: an untranslated localization key is displayed as a section title.

issues.description: The section header displays a raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the translated, human-readable title (e.g., 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization string for 'home_feed.popular_title' is properly resolved and rendered as user-facing text.
